_comment: Object-pipeline tuning. A rig json can override any key under its own "objects": {...}. Distances in metres, angles in degrees, times in seconds.

quality._note: Zone cleanup before geometry. Reject a reading if sigma > max(max_sigma_mm, max_sigma_rel x distance) or signal < min_signal (kcps/SPAD). From the 2026-11-15 live sample: good returns had sigma ~1% of distance and signal 8-40 at 1-4 m. self_mask uses config/selfmask_<rig>.json (tools/learn_selfmask.py).

body_zone._note: Points inside these boxes are the wearer (shoulders, torso, arms) and are ignored. Head frame: origin = head centre at ear height, x forward, y right, z up, metres. mirror_y also applies the box on the other side. Off here; the cap rig switches it on.

_warn_note: 2026-11-15: beep only for closer things (was warn 1.5 m / urgent 0.5 m / TTC 2.0 s / 0.8 s / approach from 0.1 m/s).
_min_fresh_note: An object must be seen in this many frames' own readings before it can beep (stray blips, e.g. a shoulder during a head turn, don't). From the 2026-11-15 worn recording.
